name: Valheim
tested: playable on iPad (1.0.20, Steam): local worlds, touch gamepad.
tested_iphone: playable on iPhone 17 (1.0.20, Steam), touch gamepad, landscape. Portrait is built but not yet tested on the device.
why: Valheim quits when Steam does not start (SteamManager, ZNet) and has no offline mode, so its Steamworks stub signs in as an offline user: cloud saves off, local worlds and characters only. PlayFab Party (crossplay) fails to initialise, so online play stays off. Graphics settings come in per-platform configurations with none for iOS, so the game takes the Mac's. On an iPhone, GuiScaler's minimum width drops from 1920 to 1400 UI units: upright, the UI scale is min(w/1400, h/1080) instead of min(w/1920, h/1080), so the inventory and crafting panels (about 1310 wide) still fit and text is about 77% of its landscape size instead of 56%; landscape phones stay limited by height and do not change. Steamworks.NET's matchmaking responders (server list, ping, players, rules) hand native code a vtable of instance-method delegates, which IL2CPP refuses to marshal: the constructor threw and the first ping (Join game) crashed on the empty handle. asmtool responders gives each vtable static [MonoPInvokeCallback] trampolines that find the instance by its native address, so the Steam runtime's server list and pings (RecompSteam/matchmaking.m) reach the game as on the Mac.
